hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/review-gate.py"; [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/review-gate.py" ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; g=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null); r=$(git symbolic-ref -q refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$r" in refs/remotes/origin/main|refs/remotes/origin/master|refs/remotes/origin/develop|refs/remotes/origin/trunk) ;; *) r=refs/remotes/origin/main;; esac; k=$(git rev-parse "$r:./.claude/hooks" "$r:./.claude/skills/review-loop/scripts" 2>/dev/null | cksum | cut -d" " -f1); e="$g/nousfx-gate"; d="$e/$k"; t="$e/.tmp.$$"; if [ -n "$g" ] && { [ -f "$d/hooks/review-gate.py" ] && [ -f "$d/hooks/pr_create_parser.py" ] || { mkdir -p "$t/hooks" "$t/skills/review-loop/scripts" && git show "$r:./.claude/hooks/review-gate.py" >"$t/hooks/review-gate.py" 2>/dev/null && git show "$r:./.claude/hooks/pr_create_parser.py" >"$t/hooks/pr_create_parser.py" 2>/dev/null && { git show "$r:./.claude/hooks/git_refs.py" >"$t/hooks/git_refs.py" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$t/hooks/git_refs.py"; git show "$r:./.claude/skills/review-loop/scripts/tier.py" >"$t/skills/review-loop/scripts/tier.py" 2>/dev/null; [ ! -e "$d" ] && mv "$t" "$d" 2>/dev/null && rm -rf "$d/.tmp.$$" || { rm -rf "$t"; [ -f "$d/hooks/review-gate.py" ]; }; }; }; }; then ln -sfn "$k" "$e/current" 2>/dev/null; exec python3 -I -B "$d/hooks/review-gate.py" --budget 55 --repo-copy "$f"; fi; [ -z "$g" ] || rm -rf "$t"; raw=$(cat); i=$(printf %s "$raw" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys;p=json.load(sys.stdin);print(p.get("tool_name",""),(p.get("tool_input") or {}).get("command",""))' 2>/dev/null) || i=$raw; i=$(printf %s "$i" | tr -d '"\047\\\140'); printf %s "$i" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])gh([^[:alnum:]_]|[^[:alnum:]_].*[^[:alnum:]_])pr([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|pull-request|pulls|mr[[:space:]]+create|createPullRequest|create_pull_request' || exit 0; if [ -n "$g" ] && git rev-parse -q --verify "$r^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then if git cat-file -e "$r:./.claude/hooks/review-gate.py" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Blocked: the review gate from the default branch ($r) could not be extracted into $e (git dir not writable, or its parser or a file is missing)." >&2; exit 2; fi; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; echo "Blocked: the default branch ($r) has no review gate copy to compare with. Open this PR from a local session, or merge the gate copy to main first." >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "Blocked: cannot read the review gate from $r: fetch origin first (git fetch origin; if the default branch is not main, also git remote set-head origin -a), then try again." >&2; exit 2; }
